notes:
• Chat history: closed chats can be reopened. On the Mac the clock at the end of the tab bar lists them (⌘⇧T reopens the last one) and "+" now sits right after the last tab; on iPhone, iPad and Android "Closed chats" is in the chats menu (iPad: the tab bar's clock).
• Mac host: Claude Code starts like in Conductor: adaptive thinking with readable summaries, up to 1000 turns, the bundled Stellwerk skill (`--plugin-dir`, workspaces, `.context`, asking from the phone, branches and PRs), task tools on, chats resume from their transcript when the host lost track (broken transcripts are set aside), and edits Claude asks for outside the workspace are refused. Agents get `CONDUCTOR_*` next to `STELLWERK_*` (plus `STELLWERK_WORKSPACE_NAME`, `STELLWERK_IS_LOCAL`) and no API keys from the host's environment unless set in Settings → Environment. Codex threads get Conductor's personality, extended history, feature switches, managed-config limits and a pointer to the skill; turns OpenAI rate-limits are retried up to 4 times. Host only; the apps are unaffected.
• Mac: ⌘V of images works (screenshots, images copied in a browser, Preview or Slack, Finder files): Paste was disabled because the plain text box only read text. Images attach as `pasted-image.png` like Conductor's; a copied spreadsheet range stays text. Dropped images attach too. Context ring opens a context popover like Conductor's (tokens / window, bar, window used, input/cached/output breakdown, model) on Mac, iPhone/iPad and Android; new optional `contextUsage` on sessions, also filled for Codex chats.
• Mac: moving from Conductor brings projects only, into Stellwerk's own clones (`~/stellwerk/repos/<name>`, with `.env*`, order and icon), offered at first start with "Run agents on this Mac" and in the host settings ("Import projects from Conductor…"), cloned in the background with progress and Retry per project. Stellwerk no longer uses Conductor's files: the earlier import of workspaces and chats is gone, and an existing database is backed up once, cleaned of what was copied and its projects moved to their own clones. Mac only; the phones are unaffected.
• Scripts like Conductor: `[scripts]` (setup, run, archive, run_mode, auto_run_after_setup) from `.conductor/settings.toml`, `settings.local.toml` (edited in Settings → repository page) and legacy `conductor.json`, with Conductor's precedence. Setup runs in new and unarchived workspaces with its status over the chat ("Setup script failed — fix it?" sends Conductor's fix prompt); Run/Stop (⌘R) with a log panel and ⇧⌘B to open `localhost:$CONDUCTOR_PORT`; archive script before the worktree is removed. `CONDUCTOR_*` variables (port 55000 + 10 per workspace) with `STELLWERK_*` twins for scripts and agents. iPhone, iPad and Android show setup status, Run/Stop and the logs.
• Entire built in: the Mac app brings the Entire CLI (0.12.2, pinned and checksummed; your own `entire` wins when at least as new) and puts it on the PATH of agents and git, so Entire's hooks work. Adding a project (Mac, iPhone/iPad, Android, Conductor import) has "Enable Entire for this project", on by default (`entire enable` for Claude Code and Codex plus git hooks); projects without it get "Enable Entire" in their menu and empty team list. Host Settings → Entire: log in (device code), log out, install the command line tool. Wire: optional `enableEntire` on add/clone requests, `RepoSummary.entireEnabled`, `POST /api/repos/:id/entire`.
• Mac: the chat and the message box look and behave like Conductor's. Geist and Geist Mono are bundled (OFL), Conductor's palette and lucide icons (1px strokes). Turns in the 896 column; the user bubble on `--highlight` with a copy button on hover; replies as Conductor's prose (14/24 at 450, its spacing, headings, bordered inline code, code blocks on `--muted` with copy on hover and no header, tables); tool calls as 32pt rows with per-tool labels (Bash description + command pill, "Read", "grep for '…'", "Edit", "3 todos", "Propose plan" open with copy …), +/− on hover, open state kept; groups ("3 tool calls, 2 messages, 1 subagent") only once a turn is over, fewer than 3 stay rows, the segment's last reply, errors, plans and questions stay out; footer with duration · time (popover), copy, "…" (Fork/Reset shown disabled, the host can't yet), changed files (3, or 2 + "+N more"); "Interrupted by user" badge; errors as Conductor's destructive badge; the working row is Conductor's Lottie loader with a tenths timer (150 ms fade), the waiting row the same; it follows new output only while at the end, keeps the reader's place when older turns load, "Scroll to bottom" after 400pt; minimap of prompts at the top right (hover lists them, click scrolls); empty chat "New chat in /path"; Conductor's permission card, plan bar (Approve ⌘⇧↵) and question card. Chat tabs: 176pt, 12pt medium, 2pt underline, Conductor's status marks (typing/waiting loaders, unread dot), ✕ on hover with the title fading. Message box: Conductor's geometry (radius 12, 16/16/12/18, min 152, text 14/20 at 350), attachments as inline pills (image thumbnail, ✕ on the icon), pasted text named `pasted_text_YYYY-MM-DD_HH-MM-SS.txt`, model picker popover (search, favourites ⌃⌘1–5, Agent/Model/Effort flyouts, ⌘⇧/ cycles effort, ⌘/ opens it), "+" menu (Plan mode ⇧Tab, Add attachment ⌘U), context ring from 70 % (red above 90 %) or always with "Always show context usage" (default on for now), stop/send as Conductor's, "⌘L to focus", drop overlay. Plan mode (⇧Tab, striped tint) runs Claude with `--permission-mode plan` for the next prompts; approving the plan continues without asking.
• Mac: Settings → Appearance → Color theme: Conductor (as before) or Ayu Dark (the VS Code theme's backgrounds, borders and #E6B450 accent; always dark). Switches live. Mac only: iPhone, iPad and Android keep their system appearance.
• Mac: "Open in" split button in the workspace header like Conductor's: the last-used app's icon opens the workspace folder in it, ▾ lists the installed apps (Finder, VS Code, Cursor, Zed, Xcode, Terminal, iTerm, Ghostty, Warp, JetBrains IDEs, Fork, Tower, GitHub Desktop …) and Copy path. Only for workspaces on this Mac. The host now sends each workspace's folder (`path`, optional, also in the Android models; the phones don't show it). Right panel: hairline under the PR button bar, in line with the header's.
• Mac: model presets like Conductor's loadout: Settings → Default models holds up to five (agent, model, effort, Fast; the first is the default for new chats), drag to reorder, click to change effort or Fast; the composer's picker lists them at the top (⌃⌘1–5) with "Add models", hover flyouts for Agent, Model and Effort, a Fast switch (⌘⇧E) and "Edit". Fast mode works end to end for Claude Opus 4.8/5.x (`--settings {"fastMode":true}` per chat, ⚡ in the composer). Unsent drafts are kept per chat across chats, workspaces and restarts, with a pencil on the chat's tab (iPad too). Popovers open from their anchor (context usage, effort flyout), the tab's ✕ no longer vanishes under the pointer, the host switcher is Conductor's account popover, the workspace header's "…" menu is gone, and the menu bar panel has "Copy pairing link" again. Wire: `SessionSummary.fast`, `ModelOption.fast`, `SelectModelRequest.fast` (optional) and `GET/PUT /api/presets`; the phones don't show presets or Fast yet, and Android has no chat tabs, so no draft pencil there.
• Mac: right panel like Conductor's (⌥⌘B, resizable): the PR button with ▾ for the alternatives (moved out of the header; PR chip and status stay there), Changes (files with folder, +/−, added/modified/deleted/renamed badge; a click opens the file's diff as a tab next to the chats) and Checks. Renamed files now come as one "old → new" entry (new optional `oldPath` on the diff's files). Mac only: iPhone, iPad and Android keep their changes sheet and git bar.
• Mac: Settings is a page in the window like Conductor's (⌘, or the Mac menu → Settings): settings nav with search (⌘F), General (send with ↩/⌘↩, queue or steer, notifications, completion sound, auto-convert long text, always show context usage, keep awake, open at login, run agents here), Account (GitHub, Entire login, pairing QR/link, Tailscale Serve, push test, other Macs), Appearance (theme), Keyboard shortcuts, Default models (agent/model/effort for new workspaces and chats, any device; host-side, no wire change, `/api/agents` lists the default agent first), Git (branch prefix, delete branch on archive), Agents (Claude Code/Codex paths and versions, Entire CLI), Environment (variables passed to agents), one page per repository (paths, remote, base branch, Enable Entire, `.worktreeinclude`, remove), Experimental, Advanced (Conductor import, folders, port, activity, updates). The Host Settings window is gone; the menu bar panel shows only status, Open Stellwerk and Quit. Mac only: iPhone/iPad and Android keep their own Settings.
• iPhone, iPad and Android: the chat's model picker shows the Mac's presets on top ("Opus 5.5 · High ⚡", ↗ when it opens a new chat) and a Fast switch for models that have it; the composer shows ⚡ in fast mode. New workspace offers the presets too, the first picked by default, and starts with its effort and Fast (`NewWorkspaceRequest.effort`/`fast`, ignored by older hosts). Presets stay read-only on phones: edit them on the Mac in Settings → Default models. Hosts before presets: no section.
• Projects in the sidebar and workspace list keep the order they were added in (like Conductor), no longer sorted by latest activity. Rearrange them by dragging a project header on the Mac, or with **Reorder projects** in a project's long-press menu on iPhone/iPad (drag handles) and Android (move up/down). Host: `PUT /api/repos/order`; reordering or adding a project reloads the list on every app.
• Search merges duplicates: an archived workspace shows once (its Entire sessions no longer show beside it; the host now matches sessions to archived workspaces too, `TeamSession.workspaceArchived`), with "N chats". A teammate's Entire sessions on one branch become one row with "N chats". Opening such a row (or an archived workspace) shows a read-only view with a tab per chat and Restore, or Continue/Open workspace for the open tab's session. Archived workspaces list their chats (`ArchivedWorkspace.sessions`). The Team chats block sits right under each project's name, before its workspaces, and lists every still-active branch ("2 active · 26"); merged and archived ones behind "Show all". Mac, iPhone/iPad and Android alike; older apps keep working.
• Search (Mac, iPhone/iPad, Android): Refresh button back in the top bar (⇧⌘R on Mac and iPad; ⌘R stays Run), a spinner in its place and a "Loading team sessions…" row while Entire answers. Refresh skips the host's 30 s team cache (`GET /api/team/sessions?refresh=1`; older hosts ignore it). Mac Search rows: local workspaces show a git-branch icon, archived ones an archive icon in the leading slot (phones already had them). Scanning the pairing QR code no longer looks like nothing happened: iPhone/iPad and Android show "Connecting to https://…:8443…", then "Paired with …" and switch to that Mac, or an alert saying what's wrong (Mac not reachable → check Tailscale and Tailscale Serve; token rejected; incomplete link), on any screen. The pairing check gives up after 15 s instead of 45 s. Mac host checks whether Tailscale Serve still forwards :8443 to Stellwerk and warns in Settings → Account (Pair a phone, Tailscale Serve) and the menu bar when it's off.
• Search and Team chats rows (Mac, iPhone, iPad, Android): a colored bar on the left says the same everywhere, in Conductor's colors: white while worked on, green when a pull request is ready to merge, purple when merged or archived, gray when stale. It replaces the state pill in those lists (the pill stays in the detail view; hover the bar on the Mac). Team branches with a mergeable pull request now show "Ready to merge".
• New workspace picks the agent (Claude Code or Codex) and its model. New Team view lists your team's Entire sessions, shows them read-only and continues one in a new workspace. No more Conductor or Accessibility mentions. iOS and Android.
• Mac app laid out like Conductor: own sidebar (projects, compact workspace rows, Team at the top) beside the workspace instead of a split view, so nothing sits under the sidebar; Conductor's type sizes; header with branch and git state, underline chat tabs. Per-project "+" creates and opens a workspace without a dialog; top "+" adds a project (folder or clone from GitHub, also on iPhone/iPad/Android). New message box: ⌘V screenshots and Finder files as attachments, drag and drop, "/" commands and "@" file mentions, model picker, stop. Transcript groups a turn's tool calls, thinking and messages into one row ("3 tool calls, 2 messages") on all apps. Team sessions in the main area with search, project/people filters, sort and grouping (filters also on iPhone/iPad/Android). The Mac app can connect to another Mac's host instead of running one. Host: `POST /api/repos/clone`, `GET /api/github/repos`, `GET /api/workspaces/:id/files`; a chat without messages switches agent in place. Fixed a layout loop that crashed the Mac app.
• Stellwerk Host gets a window: the Stellwerk app itself (workspaces, chats, git bar, changes, new workspace, team), talking to the host inside it, no pairing. Closing it keeps the host in the menu bar. Notifications on the Mac while the window isn't in front. Needs macOS 15. iOS and Android unchanged.
• The iOS app no longer builds for the Mac through Mac Catalyst (no more TestFlight build for the Mac); the native Mac app Stellwerk replaces it, also for connecting to another Mac's host. The `MAC_PROVISIONING_PROFILE`, `MAC_DISTRIBUTION_P12` and `MAC_INSTALLER_P12` secrets and `scripts/ci/set-mac-secrets.sh` are gone.
• Renamed to Stellwerk, so it runs next to Pocket on the same Mac and phone: Stellwerk Host and Stellwerk apps with their own bundle IDs (`de.lotum.stellwerk.*`), `stellwerk://` pairing links, port 47821, Tailscale Serve on port 8443 and `~/Library/Application Support/Stellwerk`. Pair again from Stellwerk Host. iOS and Android.
• Search replaces Team on Mac, iPhone/iPad and Android: one list of workspaces, archived workspaces (restorable) and Entire team sessions, with project, state, people, sort and grouping filters. Host: `GET /api/workspaces/archived`, `POST /api/workspaces/:id/restore`, `HealthInfo.userLogin`/`userAvatarURL`. Several paired Macs per app with a switcher (Mac sidebar header with ⌃1/⌃2…, iOS title menu, Android name menu) and "Connect another Mac…". Mac sidebar top like Conductor (Mac name + avatar, Home, Create, Search); "Run agents on this Mac" is a setting, the host keeps running while another Mac is on screen.
• Team: fixed the empty Team sheet on the Mac. Team sessions per project: a "Team" section under each project in the workspace list (Android; Mac/iOS sidebar via `TeamSidebarSection`), a project view grouped by person or day, "Everyone / Teammates / Mine" filter, the global view grouped by project. New session view with author, project, branch, agent and checkpoints, "Continue in new workspace", loading and clear error states (Entire not installed, not logged in, not enabled in the project). Host: `GET /api/team/sessions?repo=<id>`, sessions carry `localRepoId` and `mine`.
• Host: agents get Conductor's system instruction (as Stellwerk) with a chat's first message: workspace folder, gitignored `.context` (now in `.git/info/exclude` and created in every workspace), target branch for diffs and PRs, placeholder-branch note, screenshots, last-message note; plus a repository's "General preferences". The chat shows the message as typed, on all clients. New workspaces' branches are renamed in the background after the first message like Conductor (`GarreltMock/x7k2p` → `GarreltMock/add-hello-world-script`, one-shot Haiku for Claude chats, the chat's model at low effort for Codex, `<none>` retries on the next message, `-v2` when taken; skipped once pushed or for workspaces on an existing branch); the workspace's name follows. Settings → Git: "Automatically rename new branches"; repository settings: "Branch rename preferences" and "General preferences".
• Team chats: finer branch states on Mac, iPhone/iPad and Android: "PR open", "Draft PR", "Active", "Stale" (branch still there, nothing for over 7 days, by session time and the branch's latest commit), "Merged", "Archived". The badge sits right after the title; stale, merged and archived titles are dimmed. The sidebar's team block shows only PR open, Draft PR and Active; Search filters "Team active", "Team stale", "Team merged/archived". Older apps keep seeing "active"/"merged"/"archived" (new optional `branchDetail` field).
• Team chats: under each project (Mac sidebar again, iPhone/iPad, Android) a block of its own with "Team chats", the count, the three latest sessions (avatar, title, who and when, branch state) and "Show all" (phones: the Team sheet; Mac: Search on the project's team sessions); collapsible, remembered. On the phones a "Team chats" row atop the workspace list opens every project's. The host now tells what became of each session's branch (`branchState`: active, merged, archived; from the start of the session's log, `git ls-remote` and `gh pr list`), shown as badges and as "Team active / Team archived" in Search's filter.
• Tool calls like Conductor: one row per call with its result attached ("Read 120 lines", "grep for 'x'" with matches, Edit with +N -M, todos, web, MCP), errors under the failed call, subagents' calls nested under their Agent, and an open view per tool (command and output, diff, numbered lines, todo list, plan). Long output loads in full on demand. Same on iPhone, iPad and Android. Claude's API retries show as "Reconnecting… (attempt n/m)".
• Ayu Dark: your messages in the chat get a warm accent tint so they stand out from the background.
• Entire checkpoints now carry the whole turn, including the agent's final message: when a turn ends, the Mac host pushes the checkpoints Entire finalized at Stop if the branch is already on the remote (an agent that committed and pushed mid-turn otherwise left only the provisional checkpoint there), and fires Entire's Stop hook itself after an interrupted Claude turn, which Claude Code skips. The system instruction and the Stellwerk skill ask agents to commit as their last step.
• Session header: the project and branch chips open the repository and branch on GitHub (Mac, iPhone/iPad, Android).
• The signal lamp in the app icon is now Lotum lime (#CFFF00).
• App icon: rows a little tighter and the middle bar shorter.
• Mac: "Create" is now called "Add Project".
• Mac: the "Changes in this turn" sheet has a Done button and closes with Esc.
• Mac host: the chat's message minimap and its hover list look and behave like Conductor's (bars only as tall as the messages, a card instead of a speech-bubble popover, jump 16 pt above the turn), and the chat scrollbar is Conductor's thin 8 pt overlay thumb. Mac window only; the phone apps are unaffected.
• Mac sidebar: no settings button at the bottom; Settings is in the Mac menu at the top.
• Mac sidebar: "Home" is gone; "Search" opens the search list.
• Mac: while the window shows another Mac, the sidebar header says "Remote · via Tailscale" under its name.
• Mac: PR chip and status now in the right panel's top bar, left of the PR button (like Conductor); with the panel closed only the PR chip stays in the header and opens Checks. The Setup / Run drawer resizes by dragging its top edge (height remembered, double-click opens/closes).
• Mac sidebar: workspaces are indented under their project, hovering a workspace shows an Archive button, and the per-project Team row is gone (Team lives on the home view).
• Mac sidebar: wider (300 pt) with taller rows and more space between projects, closer to Conductor.
• Mac sidebar: the team chats block shows for every project with Entire on (loading and empty states included), loads on its own, spans the full width and indents its sessions like the workspaces.
• Mac: a turn's file chips open the file's diff in the tab next to the chats (like the Changes list), no sheet.
• iPhone/iPad and Android: no "Team chats in all projects" card above the projects anymore; each project keeps its own team chats block.
• Search: your own workspaces, active and archived, show your GitHub avatar like the team rows show their author (Mac, iPhone/iPad, Android).
• New app icon on iOS, Mac, Stellwerk Host and Android: an "S" of three bars and two blocks with a green signal lamp, in the style of Conductor's icon. Host gets a matching menu bar template image (`MenuBarIcon`), `.github/logo.png` follows. All icons come from `scripts/assets/render-stellwerk-logo.swift`.
• The Mac app is now called Stellwerk instead of Stellwerk Host.
• Stellwerk for Mac checks its own update feed, signed with Stellwerk's own key instead of Pocket's. The download page for the Mac app and the Android APK is at lotum.github.io/stellwerk-releases.
